visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with shoulder-length brown hair wearing a brown ruched top and grey pants sits at a white table in a bright, modern studio with white shelves and a green beanbag. A comic-style yellow explosion graphic appears on screen as she gestures. (2) She picks up a yellow carton of papaya milk and a white cup of yogurt. She pours the milk into a clear glass, then adds the yogurt. (3) She drinks the mixture, looking at the camera and gesturing with her fingers as she speaks. (4) She introduces a green carton of oat soy milk and a large bottle of apple juice. She pours the juice first, then the soy milk into a clean glass. (5) After drinking, she covers her mouth with a look of disgust; the screen turns grey momentarily. (6) A second woman in a black jacket enters the frame from the left to assist. (7) They stand by a shelf as the main woman holds a white and orange box of 'Super 7 Probiotics' by Grape King. (8) She is seen tearing a sachet and consuming the powder, then transitions to lifting small dumbbells and stretching happily on a white sofa. (9) She stands behind a table displaying two boxes of probiotics alongside the previous drinks, pointing to a price graphic on screen. (10) She performs a high-energy dance routine with the second woman and a man who enters from the right, featuring heart gestures and fast arm movements.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female voice opens with an enthusiastic greeting accompanied by a 'whoosh' SFX and a playful, mid-tempo synth-pop BGM. (2) Vocal tone becomes casual and conversational as she describes a drink recipe; the sound of a carton opening and liquid splashing into a glass is clearly audible. (3) The female speaker continues talking with moderate pitch variability; a 'clinking' sound of a spoon or glass is heard, followed by a slight swallow. (4) A transition SFX leads into a second recipe description; the sound of pouring liquid and a plastic bottle being squeezed is prominent. (5) The speaker's voice shifts to a higher pitch and slightly strained quality, making 'ugh' and gagging noises, followed by a light splash as she reacts to the drink's taste. (6) A second female voice is heard laughing and speaking briefly in a friendly, light tone. (7) The main female voice transitions to a professional, narrative-style promotion with clearer articulation; the BGM maintains a steady, energetic rhythm. (8) Sounds of a paper sachet being torn open and a quick 'gulping' sound are heard as she consumes the product; she continues with an excited, high-arousal delivery. (9) The audio features a rhythmic 'clapping' or 'impact' SFX synchronized with the BGM as she lists promotional details. (10) The final phase erupts with multiple voices shouting rhythmic chants like 'Here we go' and 'Let it go' over a heavy, beat-driven trap-style remix of the BGM; several high-energy shouts and 'whoosh' SFX punctuate the dancing sequence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Grape King's 'Super 7 Probiotics' by humorously contrasting them with unpleasant-tasting homemade health drinks. The creator demonstrates the failure of DIY recipes and presents the convenient, affordable, and effective probiotic product as the superior choice for digestive health and energy.
